answer: PoA binds each identity to bonded collateral in escrow, so splitting stake across aliases does not dilute accountability. When k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated evidence triggers a penalty proportional to k²; detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier through asymmetric depreciation, making a sybil swarm costlier than its nominal stake suggests. The same accounting applies across oasis, prism, and timber validator sets, preventing aliases from evading collective liability.
